# Dynamic tag labels retain original numeric positions in Fluent accesskeys

The two tag builders choose separate Fluent messages for labels with and without numeric accesskeys. Positions1–9 receive their numeric string; skipped autotags still consume their original position. The main-menu helper also sets acceltext. The keyset uses literal0–9 with its existing shift-any contract. Selected current menu tests directly assert labels, accesskeys, values, colors and checked state, but were not run. These are scoped tag-menu contracts, not a rule that all shortcuts or localized keys must be numeric literals.

Scope: Message tag menus and shortcuts.
